en: Can I enter the BukSU University Library if I don't have a physical student ID card yet?
Yes, incoming first-year students and new students who have not yet received their physical Student ID / Library Card are still permitted to enter the BukSU University Library.

Requirements for entry without physical ID: 1. Present your validated **Certificate of Registration (COR)** as proof of enrollment for the current semester. 2. Present any valid alternative photo ID (such as your SHS ID or valid government ID). 3. Sign the visitor/temporary entry logbook at the library entrance.
Once your official Student ID or barcoded Library Card is issued, you will use it for standard tap/scan entry and borrowing.
ceb: Pwede ba makasulod sa BukSU Library bisan wala pay physical student ID card?
Oo, ang mga incoming first-year students ug bag-ong estudyante nga wala pa nakadawat sa ilang physical Student ID o Library Card gitugotan gihapon nga makasulod sa BukSU University Library.

Mga kinahanglanon sa pagsulod kung wala pay ID: 1. Ipakita ang imong validated nga **Certificate of Registration (COR)** isip pamatuod nga enrolled ka karong semester. 2. Pagpakita og valid alternative photo ID (sama sa Senior High School ID o valid government ID). 3. Pagpirma sa temporary logbook sa entrance sa library.
Kung makuha na nimo ang imong opisyal nga Student ID o barcoded Library Card, mao na kini ang imong gamiton para sa scan entry ug paghulam og mga libro.
